your only competition posted nothing today 🤍

#bestversionofyou #wellness #womenshealth

slides.text:
Ever looked at body goals
on social media
and felt behind?

Those photos are
someone else's genetics,
lighting and full-time job.

Your body has its own
version of strong.

It's already in there.

The only comparison
that matters:

you, a month ago.

slides.heading: That's why there is SOMA.
slides.body: It doesn't chase someone else's body — it builds the best version of yours, from your own data
